items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A bright living room with a cream linen three-seat sofa against a warm white wall. One large framed abstract art print in a thin white oak frame with a wide cream mat hangs centered above the sofa, its bottom edge about a hand's width above the sofa back, the frame about two thirds the width of the sofa, perfectly level. Sage green cushions, a terracotta throw, a white oak coffee table, a woven jute rug, a tall plant in the corner. The artwork shows soft abstract shapes only, no letters. Straight-on view, eye level.

items.name: 02-gallery
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A hallway with a neat gallery wall of six framed prints in matching thin white oak frames arranged in a tidy 3 by 2 grid with equal narrow gaps between frames, the whole group centered above a narrow white oak console table with a ceramic vase and a small lamp. The prints show simple botanical line drawings and abstract shapes, no letters. Straight-on view, everything level and evenly spaced.

Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A calm bedroom in warm evening lamp light. Above the headboard hangs one wide framed landscape art print in a thin white oak frame, centered over the bed, its bottom edge a short distance above the headboard.
